The '''Eos system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Cadavine sector/Legends|Cadavine sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and contained the planet [[Eos]].<ref name="Starfighter" />

==History==
Prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], it was the location of a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Droid factory (Eos)|droid factory]]. The Trade Federation also used the [[Star system/Legends|system]] space prior to its [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] to secretly test the abilities of its war equipment by hired mercenaries like [[Vana Sage]].<ref name="Starfighter" />

Though in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], shortly after testing their equipment&mdash;specifically [[Scarab-class starfighter/Legends|''Scarab''-class starfighters]]&mdash;the Trade Federation quickly left the system and their hired mercenaries, including [[Nolo]], [[Skirmish at Eos|ambushed]] Sage. Sage managed to defeat her attackers and tracked a damaged [[Hunter-Seeker droid]] to Eos itself. After discovering the Trade Federation's secret [[Droid/Legends|droid]] foundry, she was trapped inside the facility. She managed to break out and quickly left the system. Sage, along with fellow pilots, [[Nym/Legends|Nym]], [[Reti]], and [[Rhys Dallows]] would later return. With Reti and Rhys Dallows taking out their orbital defenses, and Nym and Sage destroying their factories on the surface of Eos, they [[Battle of Eos (Invasion of Naboo)|destroyed]] the droid foundry and ended Trade Federation presence in the system.<ref name="Starfighter" />
